tech.summary: The Financial Times reported that OpenAI told investors its annualised revenue was approaching $50bn at end-September — about $20bn less than the $70bn figure media, including the FT, had previously reported. The discrepancy arose from investors trying to make OpenAI's number directly comparable to Anthropic's: Anthropic counts sales via cloud partners like AWS and Google Cloud, while OpenAI doesn't. Tech stocks sank anyway: Nasdaq fell 1.25% (worst day since mid-August), Nvidia dropped 2.9%, Intel 5.3%, Oracle 5.5%.
tech.title: OpenAI's revenue is ~$50bn, not $70bn — FT report sinks tech stocks

tech.summary: Google Cloud introduced the Gemini agent — a single AI agent for work that plans tasks, uses tools, connects to company business systems and delivers finished work across documents, email and developer environments. It works directly inside Google Workspace apps (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar) and also through Microsoft 365 and Slack. It picks the best model per task, running on Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. Users can create 'coworker agents' with their own email address; versions for financial services and legal are in preview.
tech.title: Google Cloud launches 'Gemini agent' — one AI agent for all your work

tech.summary: Upscale AI, valued at $2bn in June, launched Token Fabric — a hardware-plus-software networking platform that lets customers build data centers using AI chips from different suppliers without integrating separate networking systems. It combines Upscale's networking chips, Nvidia Spectrum-X equipment and bottleneck-detecting software to keep expensive AI chips busy. CEO Barun Kar expects tens of millions in revenue next year; first release ships in Q4, full rollout through 2027. Total funding stands at $500m.
tech.title: Nvidia-backed Upscale AI launches 'Token Fabric' to mix rival AI chips in one data center

tech.summary: The White House announced $2.4bn in AI tools and compute credits from 11 tech partners for the Genesis Mission Consortium, which applies AI to federal scientific research across 14 agencies in energy, health and space. Nvidia committed $1bn, AMD $500m, OpenAI $200m, and Anthropic and Google $150m each. Trump also used the announcement to double down on rebranding AI as 'super intelligence,' writing that the White House considers anyone using the old term 'THE ENEMY'.
tech.title: Tech giants pledge $2.4bn in AI compute for White House's Genesis Mission

tech.summary: A leaked prospectus suggests Anthropic is targeting a $2 trillion IPO valuation — roughly double its reported $965bn May valuation — with the listing pushed to November. The documents project $4.6bn in 2025 revenue (12x growth over 2024) against a $42bn net loss (much of it a non-cash financing charge), over $500bn in future infrastructure spending commitments, and reveal that 25% of revenue comes from just two customers without long-term contracts.
tech.title: Leaked Anthropic prospectus: $2 trillion IPO target, $42bn net loss

pakistan.summary: The WTO sharply upgraded its 2026 global merchandise trade growth forecast to 3.9% (from 1.9%) on the back of the AI boom, and named Pakistan among nations benefiting from trade disruptions amid the Middle East conflict. Pakistan's exports of sea freight transport services rose 73% year-on-year in H1 2026 as rerouted traffic boosted Karachi; vessel calls at Karachi terminals were still 14% higher in July. Pakistan's computer services exports jumped 23% in Q2. The flip side: MSC imposed a $500-per-container congestion surcharge on shipments to Pakistan.
pakistan.title: WTO: Pakistan's sea-freight exports up 73% as global trade beats expectations

pakistan.summary: The IMF concluded its fortnight-long review without announcing a staff-level agreement, asking for more data on the proposed time-of-use electricity tariff for industry — designed to push factories toward cheap night and solar-hour rates and fix the 'duck curve' caused by Pakistan's solar shift. Officials say talks concluded successfully and expect the $1.2bn tranche after board approval within four to five weeks. Gas sector circular debt has swollen to around Rs3.6 trillion.
pakistan.title: IMF holds back clearance for industry power tariff plan; $1.2bn tranche expected in 4-5 weeks

pakistan.summary: Outstanding SME loans rose by Rs23bn in Q1 FY27 to Rs1.137 trillion, with borrowers up by over 25,000 to about 350,862, Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said after the Access to Finance Steering Committee meeting. He flagged data gaps hampering responsible lending decisions and set a medium-term target of Rs2 trillion in SME financing with 775,000 borrowers by June 2028, alongside Rs222bn in total financing to housing, SMEs, agriculture and EVs in the quarter.
pakistan.title: Outstanding SME loans hit Rs1.137 trillion; borrowers up 25,000

pakistan.summary: At the UNGA Second Committee, Pakistan's deputy permanent representative Usman Jadoon called for a credible pathway to mobilise $300bn in climate finance, tripling adaptation finance and full funding of the Loss and Damage Fund. He demanded the 2026 and 2028 UN Water Conferences focus on shared waters, stressed respecting the sanctity of existing treaties — a pointed reference in the Indus waters context — and called for reform of the international debt architecture, noting the $4 trillion annual SDG financing gap.
pakistan.title: Pakistan demands $300bn climate finance pathway at the UN

pakistan.summary: A seven-year-old boy was killed in Mardan's Katlang area when his house roof caved in under heavy rain; his mother and minor sister were injured, and two women were hurt in a similar incident in Bala Ghari. Peshawar received 38mm of rain — its heaviest in the province — inundating major roads and tripping 83 Pesco feeders. A hailstorm in Mohmand district destroyed standing tomato, coriander and chilli crops and smashed rooftop solar panels; farmers who borrowed money to cultivate are demanding compensation.
pakistan.title: Child killed, four injured as heavy rains batter Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

pakistan.summary: A viral video from a PCB dinner showed the team manager gesturing at Hasan Nawaz and Naseem Shah to remove their caps while greeting chairman Mohsin Naqvi — sparking online debate over whether it was proper protocol or patronising treatment of national players. It comes hours before Pakistan's home T20I series against Sri Lanka begins today (Oct 9) at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, with Sahibzada Farhan captaining Pakistan; matches also on Oct 11 and 13, followed by an ODI tri-series with England and Sri Lanka.
pakistan.title: Viral: Pakistan cricketers told to remove caps in front of Mohsin Naqvi ahead of Sri Lanka T20Is
